lead.headline: Won by 72, now a bye is in the lineup
lead.deck: 158.06 to 86.24 in Week 8, 5.9 left on the bench. Week 9: Warren on bye in an RB slot, Tuten DNP Monday, Murray's hamstring — and the Coker claim clears at 02:00.
lead.body: The bad news first. Jaylen Warren is in a starting RB slot and Pittsburgh are on bye; as set, AVIATO project 110.0 against Talla Metralla's 126.8. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Monday with an ankle and foot problem and plays Thursday at Baltimore, 4th-toughest against backs. Kyler Murray, Jefferson's and Hockenson's quarterback, has a hamstring with no diagnosis; Carson Wentz is behind him. Week 8 was a 158.06 to 86.24 win, with Diggs's 12.8 left on the bench behind Gordon's 6.9 — the projection's call, no override. Setting the projection lineup — Diggs into the FLEX, Gordon to RB, Likely at TE — makes it 124.3. The Coker claim, for the spare kicker, is the last waiver move before claims process at 02:00 Wednesday.
